blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As agents enter enterprise and scientific workflows, tasks that depend on professional experience require them to understand context, make sound judgments, and choose appropriate actions. Much of the experience they need is spread across practitioners and work records. Turning it into traceable, reusable corpora strengthens task execution and preserves critical know-how. Major national initiatives reflect the international importance of this need. China’s AI Plus initiative calls for reusable expert knowledge and high-quality datasets [ 1 ] . In the United States, the Genesis Mission calls for an integrated AI platform that uses federal scientific datasets to develop scientific foundation models and agents for hypothesis testing and research automation [ 2 ] . Together, these initiatives highlight a shared priority: making domain knowledge usable by AI systems. By turning professional experience into reusable assets for agents, KUPAS MASTER addresses a problem of global significance for industrial productivity and scientific innovation.
blocks.zh: 随着代理商进入企业和科学工作流程,依赖于专业经验的任务要求他们了解背景,做出合理的判断,并选择适当的行动. 他们需要的许多经验分散在从业人员和工作记录中。 把它变成可追踪的,可重复使用的公司加强任务执行,并保存关键的专门知识. 主要的国家举措反映了这一需要的国际重要性。 中国AI Plus倡议呼吁重用专家知识和高质量数据集 [1]. 在美国,创世纪使命呼吁建立一个集成的AI平台,利用联邦科学数据集开发用于假说测试和研究自动化的科学基础模型和剂[2]. 这些举措共同突出了一个共同的优先事项:使人工智能系统能够使用域知识。 KUPAS MASTER通过将专业经验转化为可重复使用的资产,解决了对工业生产力和科学创新具有全球意义的问题。

blocks.en: Organizing professional experience for AI systems is therefore an important problem in enterprise knowledge management. A maintenance expert may combine an unusual sound, recent repair records, and operating load to diagnose a fault. A mediator may first verify disputed facts before discussing responsibility. In both tasks, useful experience includes the evidence behind a decision, the alternatives considered, the conditions for an action, and the reasons to stop or change course. Without those conditions, another practitioner or agent may apply a useful rule to the wrong case.
blocks.zh: 因此,为人工智能系统组织专业经验是企业知识管理的一个重要问题。 维修专家可以结合不寻常的声音、最近的修理记录和操作负荷来诊断故障。 调解人可在讨论责任之前先核实有争议的事实。 在这两项任务中,有益的经验包括决定背后的证据、考虑的替代办法、采取行动的条件以及停止或改变路线的理由。 如果没有这些条件,另一名从业人员或代理人可对错误案件适用一条有用的规则。

blocks.en: Organizations already keep manuals, work orders, incident reports, recordings, and case reviews. Yet terminology varies, intermediate decisions go unrecorded, and observations made at the time may be mixed with later explanations. A record of a successful intervention may omit the conditions that made it work. Rare but serious failures may survive only in conversation and remain unavailable to text retrieval. Knowledge acquisition research has long studied how to recover such information from actual work. The Critical Decision Method, for example, uses structured questions about specific incidents to identify the cues and reasoning that experienced practitioners relied on [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 各组织已保存手册、工作命令、事件报告、录音和案件审查。 然而,术语不同,中间决定没有记录,当时提出的意见可能与后来的解释混为一谈。 成功的干预记录可能忽略使其发挥作用的条件。 很少但严重的故障可能只在谈话中存在,并且仍然无法进行文本检索。 知识获取研究长期研究如何从实际工作中收回此类信息. 例如,关键决定方法利用关于具体事件的结构化问题来确定经验丰富的从业人员所依赖的提示和推理[3、4、5]。

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) offer new ways to organize and use these materials. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) brings external text into inference [ 6 ] , graph retrieval uses relationships across records [ 7 ] , and agent frameworks connect reasoning with tool use [ 8 , 9 ] . These methods help retrieve and use existing information. Several questions remain about the experience itself: how to fill gaps, express conditions of use, handle conflicting accounts, and check whether an extracted procedure can actually be followed. Answering them requires attention to how the underlying experience was collected, organized, and reviewed.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)为这些材料的组织和使用提供了新的途径. 检索增强生成(RAG)将外部文本引入推论[6],图检索使用跨记录的关系[7],代理框架将推理与工具使用[8,9]连接起来. 这些方法有助于检索和使用现有信息。 经验本身还存在若干问题:如何填补空白、明确使用条件、处理相互矛盾的账目、以及检查能否实际遵循提取的程序。 回答这些问题需要注意如何收集、组织和审查基本经验。

blocks.en: KUPAS MASTER calls this process experience engineering : acquiring, structuring, validating, and maintaining experience so that it becomes reusable, reviewable knowledge. Here, an experienced practitioner is someone who can contribute practical knowledge about a specific task and context. The platform links that knowledge to its task, conditions, and supporting evidence so that others can understand and review the judgment before reusing it. It also records additions and revisions through version control, supporting expert review, source tracing, and later agent use.
blocks.zh: KUPAS MASTER称这个过程体验工程:获取,构建,验证,以及保持经验,使其成为可重复使用,可审查的知识. 在这里,经验丰富的从业者是能够提供具体任务和背景的实际知识的人. 该平台将知识与其任务、条件和支持性证据联系起来,以便其他人在重新使用之前能够理解和审查判断。 它还通过版本控制,支持专家审查,源头追踪,以及后来的剂用,记录添加和修改.

blocks.en: For this report, we randomly selected 20 authorized platform users from different professional domains and examined their corpora, assets, and run records. The sample contains 1,576 source files, 30,762 corpus chunks, 23,024 individual experience records, and 13,113 organizational assets. These counts correspond to source collection, parsing, experience extraction, and organizational consolidation.
blocks.zh: 对于这份报告,我们随机选择了来自不同专业领域的20个授权平台用户,并检查了他们的公司,资产,运行记录. 样本中包括1 576份原始档案、30 762个单位、23 024份个人经验记录和13 113项组织资产。 这些计数对应于来源收集、分析、经验提取和组织整合。

blocks.en: We compare three agent configurations on the same tasks under a shared scoring rubric: a base-model agent (A), an agent using raw-corpus RAG (B), and an agent using KUPAS MASTER experience assets and skills (C). The evaluation contains 177 questions and 531 responses. We average the platform-reported practitioner scores equally across the 20 practitioners; each score combines seven weighted dimensions. The scores are 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58 for A, B, and C. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of nine-layer cognitive corpus construction, with consistent improvements in task quality, professional judgment, and execution. Later sections explain the evaluation and the role of experience assets in these gains.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个共享的评分标题下比较了相同任务的三种代理配置:一种是基模代理(A),一种是使用原始公司RAG(B)的代理,另一种是使用KUPAS MASTER体验资产和技能的代理(C). 评价包含177个问题和531个答复。 我们平均看,平台报告的执业者在20名执业者中得分相等;每分结合7个加权维度. 得分分别为70.63分,79.75分和89.58分,分别是A,B和C. 结果显示了九层认知体构建的有效性,任务质量、专业判断和执行方面不断提高。 后面各节解释评价以及经验资产在这些收益中的作用。

blocks.en: The platform makes four main contributions. A structured representation of expert experience connects six case elements, nine extraction dimensions, and six asset types in a common format for collection, review, tracing, and execution. An experience corpus construction workflow converts heterogeneous work records into candidate assets while retaining their evidence, context, and review status. Organizational consolidation compares and combines experience under explicit task conditions. It keeps context-dependent alternatives separate and flags conflicts, disagreements, and insufficient evidence for review. Finally, skill construction and evaluation turns these assets into callable procedures and compares their use against the base model and raw-corpus RAG.
blocks.zh: 平台主要贡献四大. 专家经验的结构化表述将六个案件要素、九个提取层面和六个资产类型联系起来,以共同的格式进行收集、审查、追踪和执行。 经验体构建工作流程将各种工作记录转换为候选资产,同时保留其证据、背景和审查状况。 组织合并在明确的任务条件下比较和综合经验。 它将视具体情况而定的备选办法分开,并标出冲突、分歧和审查证据不足。 最后,技能建设和评价将这些资产转化为可调用的程序,并将其使用与基础模型和原始公司RAG进行比较。

blocks.en: The following sections introduce task scope, experience representation, corpus construction, and organizational consolidation, with examples from the authorized sample. Section 8 describes the evaluation design, including controls for model configuration, input information, and runtime resources.
blocks.zh: 以下各节介绍任务范围、经验说明、实体建设和组织整合,并举例说明授权样本。 第8节描述了评价设计,包括对模型配置的控制、输入信息和运行时间资源。

blocks.en: 2  System Overview and Task Scope
blocks.zh: 2 系统概览和任务范围

blocks.en: 2.1  Using the system
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 使用系统

blocks.en: Figure 1 : System overview of KUPAS MASTER and its architecture for using professional experience.
blocks.zh: 图1:KUPAS MASTER及其结构利用专业经验的系统概览。

blocks.en: The KUPAS MASTER workflow starts with a clearly scoped task. The task description identifies the practitioner’s role, the object of work, the environment, available tools, triggers, and the extent of a single case record. It also defines completion criteria and the decisions the agent is allowed to make. A broad label such as “industrial maintenance” is too vague to guide experience collection. A more useful definition names a component and its operating conditions, then limits the task to gathering information, analyzing the problem, and recommending repairs within the authorized scope.
blocks.zh: KUPAS MASTER工作流程从明确范围的任务开始。 任务说明确定了从业人员的作用、工作对象、环境、可用的工具、触发因素和单一案件记录的范围。 它还规定了完成标准和允许代理人作出的决定。 “工业维护”等宽泛的标签过于模糊,无法指导经验收集。 一个更有用的定义将一个部件及其操作条件命名,然后将任务限制在收集信息、分析问题和建议在授权范围内进行修理。

blocks.en: Once the scope is clear, the practitioner and collection assistant prepare a task description and evidence collection plan. They record key observations, judgments, decisions, exceptions, and outcomes. Missing information prompts targeted follow-up. If a diagnosis lacks an important measurement, for example, the next step is to locate the measurement record or clarify it in an interview. This preserves a clear link between facts, judgments, and outcomes.
blocks.zh: 一旦范围明确,从业者和收集助理将编写任务说明和证据收集计划。 它们记录关键的意见、判决、裁决、例外和结果。 缺少信息会引发有针对性的后续行动。 例如,如果诊断缺乏重要的测量,下一步是找到测量记录或在采访中加以澄清。 这保持了事实、判决和结果之间的明确联系。

blocks.en: One practitioner in our sample mediates workplace injury disputes. Their tasks include assessing the nature and causes of an injury, calculating compensation items, negotiating disputes, and reviewing agreements. Relevant evidence includes responsibility findings, medical records, attendance records, and proof of third-party payments. The task specification also defines the mediator’s authority: mediation and advice do not replace judicial decisions. Matters outside that authority, or disputes that remain unresolved, follow the appropriate referral procedure. These requirements give experience collection a concrete focus on evidence, reasoning, steps, and conditions of use.
blocks.zh: 我们抽样的一位从业者调解了工作场所的伤害纠纷。 他们的任务包括评估伤害的性质和原因、计算赔偿项目、谈判争端和审查协议。 有关证据包括责任认定、医疗记录、出勤记录和第三方付款证明。 任务规定还界定了调解人的权力:调解和咨询不能取代司法裁决。 超出该权限的事项或仍未解决的争端,遵循适当的移交程序。 这些要求使收集经验具体侧重于证据、推理、步骤和使用条件。

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the platform architecture. Its seven-step workflow is grouped in Figure 2 . The platform defines the task, collects evidence, and aligns terms, entities, and events. It then extracts candidate assets from individual cases, compares and consolidates experience across practitioners, and reviews evidence, applicability, and wording. We call this stage cross-review . The platform label “cross-validation” refers to this content review, rather than k k -fold cross-validation. Reviewed assets then support agent evaluation. Evaluation findings feed back into collection and revision.
blocks.zh: 图1显示了平台架构. 其七步工作流程归入图2。 该平台定义任务,收集证据,并协调术语,实体和事件. 然后从个案中提取候选资产,比较和综合从业人员的经验,审查证据、适用性和措辞。 我们称之为这个阶段的交叉审查。 标注“交叉验证”的平台是指这一内容审查,而不是kk-fold交叉验证。 经审查的资产随后支持代理人评价。 评价结果反馈到收集和修订中。

blocks.en: Two distinct records run through the workflow. A case record describes what happened during a particular task, including its context, observations, actions, and outcome. An asset record captures reusable experience drawn from one or more cases. Their relationship is many-to-many: one case may support several assets, and one asset may draw on several cases. Keeping these records separate preserves the original events while allowing interpretations and generalizations to be revised.
blocks.zh: 两个不同的记录贯穿工作流程。 案例记录描述了某项任务期间发生的情况,包括其背景、观察、行动和结果。 资产记录可以记录从一个或一个以上案件中得出的可重复使用的经验。 它们之间的关系是多方面的:一个案件可能支持若干资产,一个资产可能利用若干案件。 保持这些记录分开保存原始事件,同时允许修改解释和概括.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : The seven-step KUPAS MASTER workflow, grouped into data collection, experience construction, and agent evaluation. Solid arrows show processing order. The dashed loop returns evaluation findings to corpus revision. Each stage retains source references, conditions of use, review status, and version identifiers.
blocks.zh: 图2:KUPAS MASTER七步工作流程,分为数据收集、经验构建和代理评价。 固体箭头显示处理顺序. 破解的循环将评价结论反馈给保单修订。 每个阶段都保留源参考、使用条件、审查状况和版本标识符。

blocks.en: 2.2  Platform responsibilities
blocks.zh: 2.2 平台责任

blocks.en: The platform acquires, structures, reviews, selects, and maintains experience. The language model handles task understanding and reasoning, while domain tools obtain external observations or perform authorized actions. Model services connect through a common interface to reduce the effect of model differences on the surrounding workflow.
blocks.zh: 该平台获取、结构、审查、选择和维持经验。 语言模型处理任务理解和推理,而域工具则获得外部观察或执行授权动作. 模型服务通过共同接口连接,以减少模型差异对周围工作流程的影响.

blocks.en: To make a run traceable and reviewable, its record should include the task specification, model and model version, asset versions, retrieval configuration, and tool permissions. A model change should trigger evaluation on the same fixed tasks with other conditions held constant. Section 10 describes deployment and implementation configurations. The next sections explain how nine-layer cognitive corpus construction supports representation, corpus building, consolidation, and agent integration.
blocks.zh: 为了使可追踪和可审查运行,其记录应包括任务规格、模型和模型版本、资产版本、检索配置和工具权限。 模型改变应触发对相同固定任务的评价,同时保持其他条件不变。 第10节介绍了部署和执行的配置。 接下来的章节解释了九层认知体构建如何支持代表,实体构建,整合,以及代理融合.

blocks.en: 3  Structured Representation of Expert Experience
blocks.zh: 3. 专家经验的结构化表述

blocks.en: KUPAS MASTER represents experience through case records, extraction dimensions, and asset types. These describe the task process, capture the basis of expert judgment, and organize reusable content, respectively (Figure 3 ). Their connections are many-to-many: a case can involve several dimensions, and a skill can draw on several asset types.
blocks.zh: KUPAS MASTER通过案例记录、提取维度和资产类型代表经验。 这些说明描述了任务过程,抓住了专家判断的基础,并分别整理了可重复使用的内容(图3 )。 它们之间的联系是多方面的:一个案例可以涉及几个层面,一个技能可以借鉴几个资产类型.

blocks.en: Table 1: Case elements and recording requirements. Facts, judgments, and execution states remain distinct, and missing fields are explicit.
blocks.zh: 表1:案件要素和记录要求。 事实、判决和执行状态仍然不同,缺失的领域很明确。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : The nine extraction dimensions, grouped by function. Case elements record the task process, and reviewed statements can become six types of experience asset. Dimensions and asset types have a many-to-many relationship: a skill may combine attention, decision, habit, and constraint information.
blocks.zh: 图3:按功能分类的九个提取维度。 案例要素记录了任务过程,经过审查的声明可成为六种经验资产。 维度和资产类型有着多种关系:一种技能可能结合注意力、决定、习惯和约束信息。

blocks.en: 3.1  Task cases
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 任务案件

blocks.en: Following the case elements in Table 1 , a task case is represented as e = ( c , u , j , a , b , o ) , e=(c,u,j,a,b,o), (1) where c c is context, u u cues, j j judgment, a a action, b b boundaries, and o o outcome. These elements provide a common record while allowing different execution orders. Repeated judgments and actions can be recorded as timestamped or partially ordered events, retaining their order and dependencies. Unresolved cases keep their outcome unverified; missing reasons remain explicit and can be added later.
blocks.zh: 根据表1中的案例要素,任务案例作为e=(c, u, j, a, b, o), e=(c, u, j, a, b,o), (1) c为上下文, u u 提示, j j 判断, 一个动作, b b b 边界, o 结果. 这些要素提供了共同的记录,同时允许不同的执行命令. 重复的判决和行动可以记录为时间戳或部分命令的事件,保留其顺序和依赖性. 未解决的案件无法核实其结果;缺失的原因仍然明确,可在稍后补充。

blocks.en: Several independent accounts of the same event can coexist. If practitioners disagree about an observation or fact, each account retains its source rather than being merged into a single certain statement. Earlier failed actions also remain in the record even when a later action solves the problem. They show how feedback changed the practitioner’s judgment or strategy. Keeping only the successful path would lose that part of the experience.
blocks.zh: 关于同一事件的若干独立说法可以共存。 如果从业者对某项观察或事实有不同意见,则每个账户保留其来源,而不是合并为单一的某一语句. 即使后来的行动解决了这个问题,早先失败的行动也仍然在记录中. 它们显示反馈是如何改变从业者的判断或策略的。 只有成功的道路才能失去这部分经验。

blocks.en: For workplace injury mediation, the context might be an injured construction worker requesting compensation mediation. Cues include responsibility findings, medical records, proof of employment, and insurance documents. Judgment concerns the relationship between work injury benefits and third-party payments. Actions include compensation calculations, explanations of policy and responsibility, negotiation, and agreement review. Boundaries specify that the mediator cannot replace a judicial decision and must refer unresolved disputes to arbitration or litigation. An outcome may be an agreement or a record of unresolved issues and completed referral. The six fields let reviewers examine facts, professional judgments, actions, authority, and results separately.
blocks.zh: 就工作场所伤害调解而言,背景可能是一名受伤的建筑工人要求补偿调解。 Cues包括责任认定、医疗记录、就业证明和保险文件。 判决涉及工伤津贴和第三方付款之间的关系。 行动包括计算赔偿、解释政策和责任、谈判和协议审查。 边界规定调解人不能取代司法裁决,必须将未解决的争端提交仲裁或诉讼。 结果可以是达成协议或记录未决问题和完成移交。 六个领域允许审查者分别审查事实、专业判断、行动、权威和结果。

blocks.en: 3.2  The nine-layer framework and extraction dimensions
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 九层框架和提取维度

blocks.en: The nine-layer cognitive framework supplies a common vocabulary for extraction and annotation (Table 2 ). L1–L9 follow the platform’s established terminology and denote dimensions that work together and can overlap. Figure 3 groups them into evidence and context, judgment and action, and practice and monitoring. A single statement can span several dimensions or groups.
blocks.zh: 九层认知框架为提取和注释提供了共同词汇(表2 )。 L1-L9遵循该平台的既定术语,并表明共同工作和可以重叠的维度. 图3将它们分为证据和背景、判断和行动以及实践和监测。 单一语句可以跨越多个维度或组.

blocks.en: The dimensions guide questions such as what a practitioner noticed, which evidence supported a judgment, what action followed, and how feedback changed the next step. Together with the asset types, they form the complete experience configuration evaluated on professional tasks.
blocks.zh: 这些层面指导着一些问题,例如从业者注意到什么、哪些证据支持判断、随后采取何种行动以及反馈如何改变下一步。 它们与资产类型一起构成专业任务评价的完整经验配置。

blocks.en: Table 2: Extraction questions and representative objects in the nine-layer framework. Outputs become assets after evidence and applicability review.
blocks.zh: 表2:九层框架中的采掘问题和代表性物体。 经过证据和适用性审查,产出成为资产。

blocks.en: Attention extraction requires direct or indirect evidence of what the practitioner actually attended to, such as an explanation, inspection sequence, or activity log. A model’s attention weights alone do not establish a practitioner attention pattern [ 10 ] . Anticipation records pair a prediction with its horizon and later outcome, separating prior judgment from subsequent fact. Repeated behavior supports a habit description but does not make it mandatory. Monitoring records uncertainty about judgments, evidence sufficiency, and applicability, preserving the limits on use.

blocks.en: This section explains how the nine dimensions turn factual accounts, reasoning, and action records into traceable experience units. The approach organizes linked extraction pipelines over narrative materials, explicit reasoning, action logs, and feedback, using entity-relation and event-dependency graphs. It first aligns events across sources in time, merges duplicate records only when their objects and meanings are compatible, and keeps conflicting accounts separate. Changes in meaning, task phase, or feedback state define cognitive segments with common fields for objects, evidence, actions, and outcomes. A segment may enter several pipelines. Figure 4 shows their shared dependencies and cross-layer links. The methods below are selected according to the available data. Scores and thresholds require calibration on annotated data, and all outputs begin as candidates for review.

Satisfiability means only that the encoded conditions admit a consistent solution. Unknown applicability still requires evidence and review, even if the formula is satisfiable; a solver assignment is not an observed fact. Unsatisfiable cases and cases for which the solver returns unknown go to human review. Active hard constraints must be satisfied before risk signals determine whether to request review, reduce output detail, or suppress output. Scores cannot override hard constraints. blocks.en: All nine pipelines save case and segment identifiers, graph anchors, content, conditions, sources, review status, and versions. Cross-layer mapping first checks task, object, and time scope, then uses explicit references, temporal proximity, and content agreement to find and rank candidate links. Source evidence determines whether a link is an evidence reference, candidate addition, or review constraint. Exceeding a score threshold does not by itself establish a relation type or a causal claim. Reviewed reusable content is organized into six asset types while retaining its case and graph links. Quality control checks structure, evidence, conditions, and task use. It does not require every segment to cover all nine dimensions or treat more links as higher quality. The next section discusses the framework’s functional analogies with brain systems.
blocks.zh: 所有9条管道都省下案件和段识别符,图锚,内容,条件,来源,审查状况,以及版本. 跨层映射首先检查任务,对象,时间范围,然后使用明确的引用,时间距离,以及内容协议来查找和排列候选链接. 原始证据确定一个链接是否是证据参考、候选人添加或审查限制。 超越得分阈值本身并不能证明关系类型或因果关系。 经审查的可重复使用的内容分为六种资产类型,同时保留其案例和图表链接。 质量控制检查的结构,证据,条件,任务使用. 它并不要求每个部分涵盖所有9个维度,也不要求将更多的链接视为更高的质量. 下一节讨论框架与大脑系统的功能类比。

blocks.en: 3.4  Functional correspondences with brain systems
blocks.zh: 3.4 与大脑系统的功能通信

blocks.en: The nine-layer approach provides a common vocabulary for extracting, reviewing, and reusing experience from heterogeneous sources. Its design draws inspiration from the organization of cognitive functions in neuroscience. These correspondences guide extraction questions and give the dimensions a coherent functional basis.
blocks.zh: 九层方法为提取、审查和重新利用不同来源的经验提供了共同的词汇。 其设计灵感来源于神经科学中的认知功能组织. 这些函证指导提取问题,并为维度提供一个连贯的功能基础.

blocks.en: Figure 5 connects L1–L9 to functions described in the neuroscience literature. This is an analytical framework for organizing expert experience, with many-to-many functional references to cooperating brain regions and networks. The anterior temporal lobe and distributed association cortex support semantic representation and integration, providing references for L1 knowledge and L5 association [ 11 ] . Predictive representations in hippocampal systems connect existing relationships to possible successor states, informing L5 association and L6 anticipation [ 12 ] . The frontal eye fields and intraparietal sulcus participate in goal-directed selection, which resembles the selective processing considered in L2 attention [ 13 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 图5将L1-L9与神经科学文献中描述的函数连接起来. 这是一个组织专家经验的分析框架,许多职能都提到合作脑区域和网络。 外侧时间叶和分布式关联皮层支持语义表达和融合,为L1知识和L5关联提供了参考[11]. 河马系统中的预测表述将现有关系与可能的继承国联系起来,告知L5协会和L6预期[12]. 前眼球场和诱导性溃疡(intraparietal sulcus)参与目标定向选择,这类似于L2关注中考虑的选择性处理[13,14].

blocks.en: The lateral prefrontal cortex contributes to context-dependent cognitive control, while the orbitofrontal cortex represents and compares values. These functions provide references for judgment, decision, and rule maintenance [ 15 , 16 ] . Anterior prefrontal and anterior cingulate functions related to self-monitoring, conflict detection, and adjustment offer analogies for monitoring experience [ 17 , 18 ] . Striatal circuits involved in goal-directed behavior and habitual responses inform L4 and L8 [ 19 ] . Right inferior frontal involvement in response inhibition provides a partial reference for stopping and control in L4 and L9 [ 20 ] . Together, these functional analogies organize experience extraction, while explicit records, rules, and review govern permissions and applicability.
blocks.zh: 横向前额皮层有助于上下文依赖的认知控制,而轨道前额皮层则代表并比较数值. 这些职能为判决、裁定和规则维护提供了参考[15、16]。 与自我监测、冲突发现和调整有关的前置和前置接合功能为监测经验提供了类似[17、18]。 参与目标定向行为和习惯反应的斯特里亚特电路告知L4和L8[19]. 右低级正面参与反应抑制为L4和L9的停止和控制提供了部分参考. [20]. 这些功能类比一起组织经验提取,而明确的记录,规则,和审查则管理权限和适用性.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Many-to-many functional correspondences between brain systems and the nine-layer framework, based on neuroscience studies. The upper drawing shows the right lateral hemisphere; the lower drawing projects medial and deep structures. Letters match the table rows, and arrows indicate approximate locations. References: N1 [ 11 ] ; N2 [ 13 ] ; N3 [ 14 ] ; N4 [ 15 ] ; N5 [ 16 ] ; N6 [ 12 ] ; N7 [ 17 ] ; N8 [ 18 ] ; N9 [ 19 ] ; N10 [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 图5:基于神经科学研究,大脑系统与九层框架之间的多对多功能对应. 上图显示右侧的横向半球;下图显示中间和深层结构。 字母匹配表格行,箭头表示大致位置. 参考文献: N1 [11]; N2 [13]; N3 [14]; N4 [15]; N5 [16]; N6 [12]; N7 [17]; N8 [18]; N9 [19]; N10 [20].

blocks.en: 3.5  Six experience asset libraries
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家 6个经验资产库

blocks.en: Experience assets package reusable content from case records, practitioner statements, and authoritative procedures for a defined task. The six core types are rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. “Negative examples” follows the platform’s terminology for failures, ineffective practices, and corrections; it does not mean negative-class training examples. The corner-case library records unusual situations in which routine rules may fail or need adjustment, including cases far from a numerical threshold.
blocks.zh: 从案件记录、从业人员说明和确定任务的权威程序中可重复使用的经验资产包内容。 六个核心类型是规则、制约因素、最佳做法、负面实例、角落案例和技能。 " 负面实例 " 沿用平台关于失败、无效做法和纠正的术语;这并不意味着负面等级的培训实例。 角落文件库记录了例行规则可能失败或需要调整的异常情况,包括远未达到数字阈值的案件。

blocks.en: Dimensions and asset types are connected many-to-many. L1 facts, entities, and relations generally remain in case records or the shared graph. L6 predictions stay with their horizons and observed outcomes and may also become applicability conditions for a rule, skill, or case. Several dimensions can therefore support one asset.
blocks.zh: 尺寸和资产类型互联互通。 L1 事实、实体和关系一般都留在案件记录或共用图表中。 L6预测与它们的视野和观察到的结果一致,也可能成为规则、技能或案例的适用条件。 因此,有几个方面可以支持一种资产。

blocks.en: Some content can be included as extensions. Wording styles and role preferences may be optional skill settings. Knowledge gaps remain explicit metadata that trigger collection or review, without requiring another top-level library. Common fields define the core assets, while extensions support domain-specific types in commercial deployments.
blocks.zh: 一些内容可列为扩展内容. 文字风格和角色偏好可能是可选的技能设置. 知识差距仍然是明确的元数据,引发收集或审查,而不需要另一个顶级图书馆。 共同域定义核心资产,而扩展则在商业部署中支持特定域的类型.

blocks.en: Table 3: Asset types, reusable content, and common source dimensions. Assets can combine information across dimensions.
blocks.zh: 表3:资产类型、可重复使用的内容和共同来源维度。 资产可以综合各方面的信息。

blocks.en: The sample used in this report contains 13,113 organizational assets: 3,550 rules, 2,892 best practices, 1,955 skills, 1,948 corner cases, 1,623 constraints, and 1,145 negative examples. Rules and best practices guide judgments and operations. Constraints, negative examples, and corner cases supply applicability conditions, risk information, and exceptions. Skills organize this experience into callable task procedures.
blocks.zh: 本报告使用的样本包括13 113个组织资产:3 550个规则、2 892个最佳做法、1 955个技能、1 948个角落案例、1 623个制约因素和1 145个负面实例。 规则和最佳做法为判断和业务提供指导。 制约因素、负面实例和角落案例提供适用条件、风险信息和例外。 技能将这种经验组织成可调用的任务程序。

blocks.en: Among the 53 questions with individual tool-call records, C retrieved rules in 46 runs, corner cases in 35, best practices in 33, constraints in 28, and negative examples in 18. It called skills in 46 runs. These records show how libraries are combined during retrieval, reasoning, and execution.
blocks.zh: 在涉及个别工具调用记录的53个问题中,46个程序中有C检索规则,35个程序有角落,33个程序有最佳做法,28个程序有限制,18个程序有负面例子。 它在46跑中称为技能. 这些记录显示,在检索、推理和执行过程中,图书馆是如何合并的。

blocks.en: Negative examples and corner cases serve different purposes. Negative examples preserve observed mistakes, failures, and corrections to help prevent repetition. Corner cases identify situations that require adjustment even if no failure has yet occurred. Best practices retain both outcomes and conditions for reuse. A skill combines these asset types under a common specification for inputs, steps, state transitions, and outputs.
blocks.zh: 消极的例子和角落案例有不同的目的。 负面例子保存观察到的错误、失败和纠正,以帮助防止重复。 转角情况表明,即使尚未发生失败,也需要调整。 最佳做法保留了成果和再利用条件。 在投入、步骤、状态过渡和产出的共同规定下,技能将这些资产类型结合起来。

blocks.en: 3.6  Evidence, review, and uncertainty
blocks.zh: 3.6 国家 证据、审查和不确定性

blocks.en: Every transformation should retain the source type: direct observation, practitioner account, or model proposal. A model may suggest missing relations or reconstruct possible reasons from behavior, but these remain candidate explanations for review and are stored separately from observations and practitioner statements. In this report, distillation means extracting, organizing, and consolidating experience from materials, rather than training a student model from a teacher.
blocks.zh: 每次转变都应保留源类型:直接观察、从业人员账户或模型建议。 一个模型可能暗示缺失的关系或重建行为可能的原因,但这些仍然是可供审查的候选解释,与观察和实践者的声明分开储存. 在本报告中,蒸馏是指从材料中提取,整理,巩固经验,而不是从教师中培养学生模式.

blocks.en: Review status and confidence are separate. Extraction confidence concerns whether parsing recovered the original statement accurately. Evidence sufficiency concerns whether sources support it. Applicability concerns whether it can be used in a particular task or context. The system stores these separately so reviewers can inspect each question.
blocks.zh: 审查状况和信心是分开的。 采掘的信心涉及分析是否准确收回了原始报表。 证据的充分性涉及来源是否支持证据。 适用性涉及是否可用于特定任务或背景。 系统单独储存这些,以便审查人员检查每个问题。

blocks.en: An asset may move through candidate, reviewed, active, suspended, and retired states. Review examines content, evidence, and declared scope. Activation also requires deployment and runtime checks. A correction creates a new version with a replacement link to the old one. Even when a generalization is revoked or found invalid, its original cases remain available to trace how the experience changed.
blocks.zh: 资产可通过候选人、审查、活动、中止和退休州流动。 审查内容、证据和申报范围。 启动还需要部署和运行时间检查。 更正后创建一个新版本,与旧版本有替换链接. 即使一个概括被撤销或被认定无效,其原始案例仍然可用以追踪经验的变化.

blocks.en: The organizational assets in this sample retain library versions and entry identifiers, allowing references and version relationships to be checked. Evaluation records should also include the corpus, asset versions, and runtime configuration actually used, supporting review and regression tests after changes.
blocks.zh: 本样本中的组织资产保留了图书馆版本和条目识别符,可以检查参考文献和版本关系. 评价记录还应包括实体、资产版本和实际使用的运行时间配置,支持修改后的审查和回归测试。

blocks.en: 3.7  Graph structures and requirements for agent use
blocks.zh: 3.7 剂用图结构和要求

blocks.en: Entity graphs organize task objects and relations; event and dependency graphs describe task progression and links between steps. Edge types distinguish temporal order, procedural dependency, association, and explicitly proposed causal hypotheses. Event order within a case can form a directed acyclic structure. Repeated operations or decisions can instead use repeated event instances or a separate state machine. Explicit edge types keep their meanings distinct.
blocks.zh: 实体图组织任务对象和关系;事件和依赖图描述任务进展和步骤之间的联系. 边缘类型区分时间顺序,程序依赖,关联,以及明确提出的因果假设. 案件内的事件顺序可以形成定向循环结构. 重复的操作或决定可以改用重复的事件实例或单独的状态机器. 明确的边缘类型保持其含义的区别.

blocks.en: An asset is ready for agent use when a consumer can understand its content, applicability, evidence, and permitted uses, and respond appropriately to missing prerequisites. The interface therefore needs machine-readable fields for task scope, exclusions, sources, review status, and versions. Skills also require inputs, outputs, and execution conditions. Interface validation checks that required fields and constraints are present; task evaluation checks whether the agent selects and uses the right asset in context.
blocks.zh: 一项资产在消费者能够理解其内容、适用性、证据和允许使用,并对缺失的先决条件作出适当反应时,即可供代理人使用。 因此,接口需要机器可读字段,用于任务范围、排除、来源、审查状况和版本。 技能还需要投入、产出和执行条件。 存在需要字段和制约的界面验证检查;任务评价检查代理在上下文中是否选择和使用正确的资产.

blocks.en: The following sections explain how corpus construction and consolidation produce traceable assets under these requirements. Section 7 then shows their retrieval and use in recorded workplace injury mediation tasks.
blocks.zh: 以下各节解释了根据这些要求,实体建造和合并如何产生可追踪资产。 然后,第7节显示在记录的工作场所伤害调解任务中回收和使用这些物品。

blocks.en: 4  Experience Acquisition and Corpus Construction
blocks.zh: 4 经验获取和公司建设

blocks.en: 4.1  Collecting heterogeneous evidence
blocks.zh: 4.1 收集各种证据

blocks.en: Experience collection draws on existing materials and additional records of actual work. Existing sources include case files, work logs, incident reviews, training materials, and demonstration videos. Additional collection may involve interviews, task observation, application logs, sensors, audio, and video. The right method depends on the task. An information-heavy review process may already have detailed digital records, whereas physical work often requires observation and follow-up interviews to explain changes in action. Materials should cover key decisions, outcomes, and exceptions. Interviewees should have relevant experience, be able to explain important cues, and provide cases that can be checked.
blocks.zh: 经验收集借鉴了现有材料和实际工作的其他记录。 现有资料来源包括案件档案、工作记录、事件审查、培训材料和示范录像。 其他收集可能涉及访谈、任务观察、应用日志、传感器、音频和视频。 正确的方法取决于任务. 信息繁重的审查过程可能已经拥有详细的数字记录,而实际工作往往需要观察和后续访谈来解释行动的变化。 材料应涵盖关键决定、结果和例外。 受访者应具有相关经验,能够解释重要线索,并提供可以检查的案件.

blocks.en: Process records should preserve the order of work and distinguish information available at the time from information learned later. Interviews can recover omitted observations, rejected alternatives, and conditions under which the usual procedure fails. These accounts should be marked as retrospective. Measurements or observations that remain unavailable should be listed explicitly for later collection.
blocks.zh: 流程记录应保持工作顺序,区分当时掌握的信息和后来获得的信息。 面谈可以收回省略的意见、被拒绝的替代办法和通常程序失败的条件。 这些账目应标明为追溯性账目。 应明确列出仍未获得的计量或观测数据,供以后收集。

blocks.en: The authorized sample contains 1,576 files in 13 formats: 567 DOCX, 351 PDF, 172 JSON, 154 Markdown, 131 DOC, and 95 XLSX files, plus text, webpages, images, presentations, and audio. The materials include case files, procedures, standards, training materials, interviews, question-answer records, tabular data, and de-identified records. Processing therefore needs to handle narrative text, tables, and multimodal attachments while keeping related content linked.
blocks.zh: 授权样本包含1,576个文件,格式为13种:567 DOCX,351 PDF,172 JSON,154 Markdown,131 DOC,95 XLSX文件,外加文本,网页,图像,演示,和音频. 这些材料包括案件档案、程序、标准、培训材料、访谈、问答记录、表格数据和去身份记录。 因此,处理需要处理叙述性文本、表格和多式联运附件,同时保持相关内容的联系。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Four representations in corpus construction. Source materials (S0) become case narratives (S1), which are analyzed for decision elements (S2) and converted into structured candidate records (S3). Dashed links preserve source traceability across stages.
blocks.zh: 图6:四份人身构造说明书。 原始材料(S0)成为案例说明(S1),根据决定要素(S2)加以分析,并转化为结构化候选人记录(S3)。 虚构的链接保持不同阶段的来源可追踪性。

blocks.en: 4.2  Semantic alignment
blocks.zh: 4.2 语义一致

blocks.en: The platform retains original wording while normalizing identifiers, terms, event boundaries, and units. Abbreviations, colloquial or local expressions, and ambiguous references require context. A mapping record should preserve the original phrase, normalized term, supporting context, and plausible alternatives that remain unresolved. A phrase such as “slightly hot” should become a numerical range only when measurements or a reviewed domain definition support that mapping.
blocks.zh: 该平台保留了原始措辞,同时使标识符,术语,事件边界,和单位正常化. 缩略语、口语或当地表达和含糊不清的提法需要上下文。 摸底记录应保留原来的短语、规范用语、支持上下文和尚未解决的可行替代办法。 只有在测量或经过审查的域定义支持这种绘图时,诸如“略为热”之类的短语才应成为数字范围。

blocks.en: Multimodal observations are aligned with task events and time intervals. Transcriptions and image recognition outputs retain uncertainty and source locations. Sensor records include units, sampling methods, and available calibration information. Because recognition errors can affect later rules and skills, every derived claim should remain traceable to the original record.
blocks.zh: 多式联运观测与任务活动和时间间隔相一致。 译名和图像识别产出仍然具有不确定性和源位置。 传感器记录包括单位,采样方法和现有校准信息. 由于识别错误会影响后来的规则和技能,因此每一个衍生的债权都应该能够追踪到原始记录.

blocks.en: The hypertension practitioner provides a concrete example. Their materials comprise two 2024 Chinese hypertension guidelines and XML field definitions for a hypertension follow-up dataset. The guidelines describe diagnosis, monitoring, and follow-up. The XML specifies fields such as systolic and diastolic blood pressure, body mass index, medication adherence, adverse reactions, referral reasons, and the next follow-up date. Semantic alignment connects guideline conditions to these fields, units, and value ranges while retaining guideline versions and source locations. Later follow-up entries can then use consistent fields and refer back to the relevant guideline passages. The XML supplies the data schema; actual follow-up data are entered during subsequent clinical work.
blocks.zh: 高血压医生提供了一个具体的例子。 它们的材料包括两个2024中国高血压指南和一个高血压后续数据集的XML场定义. 准则描述了诊断、监测和后续行动。 XML指定了一些领域,如血压和糖尿病,体积指数,药物坚持性,不良反应,转诊原因,以及下一个后续日期. 语义校正将准则条件与这些字段,单位,值范围联系起来,同时保留准则版本和源位置. 后来的后续条目可以使用一致的字段,并参考相关的准则段落. XML提供数据计划;在随后的临床工作中输入实际后续数据.

blocks.en: 4.3  Narrative reconstruction and structured extraction
blocks.zh: 4.3 叙述式重建和有条理的提取

blocks.en: The S0–S3 stages in Figure 6 separate case reconstruction from experience generalization. S0 retains source materials. S1 organizes the case by roles, observations, actions, and outcomes. S2 identifies decision elements, including cues, explanations, alternatives, plan changes, and uncertainty. S3 converts supported elements into structured records and graphs. All stages remain linked to their sources.
blocks.zh: 图6中的S0-S3阶段将案例重建与经验概括分开。 S0保留了源材料. S1按照角色,观察,行动和结果来组织案件. S2确定了决定要素,包括提示、解释、替代办法、计划变化和不确定性。 S3将支持的元素转换成结构化的记录和图表. 所有阶段都与其来源有关。

blocks.en: The extractors then apply the nine-layer approach in Section 3.3 . Knowledge extraction links terms and entities. Attention extraction identifies priorities supported by practitioner statements or behavioral evidence. Judgment extraction recovers conditions and conclusions. Decision extraction records actions, selection criteria, and stopping conditions. Association extraction captures related cases that the practitioner mentions, without treating similarity as causal evidence. Anticipation extraction records predictions and time horizons. Monitoring extraction records when more information, review, or referral is needed. Habit extraction requires repetition across cases. Constraint extraction distinguishes explicit prohibitions from preferences.
blocks.zh: 提取器然后在第3.3节中采用九层方法。 知识提取将术语和实体联系起来。 注意提取(reception discription)确定了有从业者声明或行为证据支持的优先顺序. 判决提取可以恢复条件和结论。 决策提取记录了行动、选择标准和停止条件。 协会提取法捕捉从业者提到的有关案例,而不将相似性作为因果关系。 期望提取记录预测和时间范围. 在需要更多信息、审查或移交时监测提取记录。 Habit 提取需要跨例重复. 约束性提取区分明令禁止和优惠.

blocks.en: An extractor may combine language model prompts, rule parsing, graph processing, and domain rules. If it involves model training, the training data, objective, and results on an independent validation set should also be recorded. Regardless of implementation, candidate assets need structured fields and supporting evidence that a reviewer can inspect.
blocks.zh: 一个提取器可以结合语言模型的提示,规则解析,图表处理,和域规则. 如果涉及示范培训,还应记录培训数据、目标和独立鉴定组的结果。 无论执行情况如何,候选资产都需要结构化的领域和审查人员可以检查的佐证。

blocks.en: Table 4: Core transformation operators and reasons to reject an output or leave it unresolved. Every operator records input and output versions and source locations.
blocks.zh: 表4:核心转换操作器和拒绝某项产出或使产出得不到解决的理由。 每个操作员记录输入和输出版本和源位置.

blocks.en: A model can propose candidates for practitioners to review against these criteria. Each stage retains its input span, proposed output, revisions, and review decision. Consider the statement “During initial intake, request verification before assigning a cause, except when a separate emergency procedure applies.” A valid rule must retain both the intake prerequisite and the emergency exception. Dropping either fails the condition-preservation check.
blocks.zh: 一个模式可以向从业人员推荐候选人,以便根据这些标准进行审查。 每个阶段都保留其投入跨度、拟议产出、修订和审查决定。 考虑以下说明:“在初次接收时,要求核查,然后确定原因,但适用单独紧急程序的情况除外。” 有效的规则必须既保留录取的先决条件,也保留紧急例外。 丢弃失败保存条件检查 。

blocks.en: 4.4  Quality control and corpus versions
blocks.zh: 4.4 质量控制和实体版本

blocks.en: Quality checks operate at three levels. Structural checks verify identifiers, required fields, valid references, and types. Semantic review checks whether evidence supports the content and its stated scope. Task review checks whether an asset helps make a decision or follow a procedure without hiding missing prerequisites. Review by other practitioners can expose ambiguities and assumptions that the original contributor takes for granted, and help distinguish personal habits from procedures suitable for wider use.
blocks.zh: 质量检查实行三级. 结构检查验证识别符,所需字段,有效引用,以及类型. 语义审查检查证据是否支持内容及其规定的范围. 任务审查检查资产是否有助于作出决定或遵循程序而不隐瞒缺失的先决条件。 其他从业人员的审查可能暴露出原始贡献者认为理所当然的含糊不清和假设,并有助于区分个人习惯与适合更广泛使用的程序。

blocks.en: Duplicate detection should consider derivation as well as text similarity. Several summaries of the same event are not independent evidence. Each experiment or deployment should fix a data version and record its source files, processing programs, active assets, and review decisions. Earlier versions must remain available after updates so that reported results can be checked.
blocks.zh: 重复检测应考虑推导和文本相似性。 同一事件的若干摘要不是独立证据。 每个实验或部署应固定一个数据版本,并记录其源文件,处理程序,活动资产,以及审查决定. 早期版本在更新后必须保留,以便检查所报告的结果。

blocks.en: The authorized source materials occupy about 1.73 GB. The file inventory marks 1,564 files as Approved and 4 as Rejected, with 8 lacking a review status. These are file counts. Task sets, corpus versions, and processing configurations are recorded separately for evaluation review.
blocks.zh: 授权源材料占地约1.73GB. 文件清单显示1 564份已核准,4份已驳回,8份未审查。 这些都是文件数。 任务集、内容表版本和处理配置单独记录,供评价审查。

blocks.en: In the comparative evaluation, adding raw-corpus retrieval raised the composite mean from 70.63 in A to 79.75 in B. The evidence sufficiency and accuracy score rose from 62.18 to 77.27. These results demonstrate that parsing, indexing, and retrieving source materials strengthen evidence-grounded answers and improve task performance.
blocks.zh: 在比较评价中,加上原始公司检索,综合平均数从A的70.63提高到B的79.75。 证据充足性和准确性得分从62.18上升到77.27。 这些结果表明,分析、索引和检索源材料可加强有证据依据的答案并改善任务业绩。

blocks.en: 5  Organizational Experience Consolidation
blocks.zh: 5 巩固组织经验

blocks.en: 5.1  From individual accounts to organizational assets
blocks.zh: 5.1 从个人账户到组织资产

blocks.en: Practitioners may agree, differ because they work under different conditions, or recommend different actions under the same conditions. Simply pooling their libraries can hide these distinctions. Before combining assets, KUPAS MASTER compares their applicability, supporting evidence, and review status.
blocks.zh: 从业人员可能同意、不同,因为他们在不同条件下工作,或建议在相同条件下采取不同行动。 仅仅集中图书馆就可以掩盖这些区别。 在合并资产之前,KUPAS MASTER比较其适用性、支持证据和审查状况。

blocks.en: The platform first aligns task identifiers, entities, terms, and asset types. Semantic similarity and scope overlap then identify entries worth comparing. Similarity is a way to find candidates, not sufficient evidence for a merge. The comparison asks whether the assets address the same decision, whether their conditions can hold together, and whether their judgments or actions are compatible.
blocks.zh: 平台首先对任务标识符,实体,术语和资产类型进行校对. 然后确定值得比较的条目。 相似性是寻找候选人的一种方法,并不是合并的充分证据. 比较时询问这些资产是否涉及同一决定,其条件能否合并,其判决或行动是否相符。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Four outcomes of organizational consolidation and their evidence requirements. Agreement retains independent support. Context-dependent alternatives remain separate. Outcome comparison requires comparable cases. Unresolved contradictions remain inactive until review. Consolidated assets retain both supporting evidence and conditions of use.
blocks.zh: 图7:组织合并的四个结果及其证据要求。 协议保留独立支持。 视具体情况而定的替代办法仍然分开。 结果比较需要可比较的案例。 未解决的矛盾在复查前仍不活跃. 合并资产既保留佐证证据,又保留使用条件.

blocks.en: 5.2  Agreement, different conditions, and conflicts
blocks.zh: 5.2 协议、不同条件和冲突

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows four consolidation outcomes. When accounts agree under the same conditions, the combined entry retains all independent sources and their derivation links. When different conditions explain different recommendations, both procedures remain available with explicit conditions. A routine inspection and a procedure for abnormal operation should not be averaged into one sequence.
blocks.zh: 图7显示四项合并结果。 如果账户在相同条件下达成一致,合并条目保留所有独立来源及其衍生链接。 当不同的条件解释了不同的建议时,这两种程序仍然有明确的条件。 日常检查和异常操作程序不应平均为一个序列。

blocks.en: When comparing alternatives, the platform organizes historical outcomes by case difficulty, operating environment, resources, and outcome definition. Historical records preserve practical evidence; controlled comparisons help assess differences between procedures under comparable conditions.
blocks.zh: 在比较替代品时,该平台按照案例难度,操作环境,资源和结果定义来组织历史成果. 历史记录保存着实际证据;有控制的比较有助于评估可比条件下程序之间的差异.

blocks.en: An unresolved contradiction remains visible as linked alternatives for review or adjudication. It should not become an unconditionally active rule. Reviewers may narrow its scope, request more cases, or decide that neither alternative is ready for use. They also distinguish formal requirements from personal preferences. A requirement grounded in a standard or procedure cannot be settled by a simple vote or a compromise with preferences.
blocks.zh: 一个尚未解决的矛盾作为审查或裁决的相互联系的替代办法仍然显而易见。 它不应成为无条件的积极规则。 审查者可能缩小其范围,要求提出更多案件,或决定这两种替代品都无法使用。 它们还将形式要求与个人偏好区分开来。 以标准或程序为基础的要求不能通过简单表决或与优惠妥协来解决。

blocks.en: For example, one intake procedure may apply when there is no emergency and another when there is an emergency. If emergency status is known, their scopes are disjoint and both can be kept. If both apply to non-emergency intake but require incompatible next actions, the platform records a conflict with the asset versions, shared conditions, and unresolved conclusion. If emergency status is unknown, the agent first asks for the missing information.
blocks.zh: 例如,在没有紧急情况时可适用一种摄入程序,在紧急情况下可适用另一种程序。 如果知道紧急情况,其范围是脱节的,两者都可以保留。 如果两者都适用于非紧急摄入,但要求采取不兼容的下一步行动,则该平台记录了与资产版本,共享条件以及未解决的结论的冲突. 如果紧急情况不明,特工首先询问缺失的信息。

blocks.en: The workplace injury mediation sample also requires separate procedures for ordinary compensation calculations, third-party commercial insurance, and statutory work injury insurance. The platform must record the insurance type, liable party, eligible compensation items, and mediation authority. A record that merely says “insurance exists” leaves applicability unknown. The agent must verify the type and beneficiary relationship before using the relevant experience. Separate conditions make it possible to retrieve the procedure that matches the case.
blocks.zh: 工伤调解样本还要求对普通赔偿计算、第三方商业保险和法定工伤保险分别采用不同程序。 平台必须记录保险类型,责任方,符合条件的赔偿项目,调解权限. 仅说“保险存在”的记录,其适用性不明。 代理人在运用相关经验前,必须核实种类和受益关系. 不同的条件使得可以检索与案件相符的程序。

blocks.en: 5.3  Cross-review and version management
blocks.zh: 5.3 交叉审查和版本管理

blocks.en: Other practitioners can review candidate assets and how they were produced. They check sources, conditions, exceptions, consistency with other assets, and possible misuse. Tests that change one important condition, such as whether a measurement is available or referral is required, help check whether applicability is clear.
blocks.zh: 其他从业者可以审查候选资产及其生产方式。 它们检查来源、条件、例外、与其他资产的一致性以及可能的滥用。 改变一个重要条件的测试,如是否具备计量条件或需要查询,有助于检查适用性是否明确。

blocks.en: Consolidation produces both organizational assets and decision records: which inputs were merged, which were kept separate, why, and what remains unresolved. Each update creates a new version. Dependencies identify skills that need revalidation after a rule changes. Version records preserve original contributions and the exact assets used in a run.
blocks.zh: 合并既产生组织资产,又产生决定记录:哪些投入被合并,哪些被分开,为什么,哪些仍未解决。 每次更新都会创建一个新版本. 依赖识别在规则变更后需要重新验证的技能. 版本记录保存原始捐款和运行中使用的确切资产。

blocks.en: In the sample collected for this report, organizational assets are stored by library and version. Records for 8 practitioners contain 37 completed cross-review jobs across the six libraries, covering 818 candidates. “Completed” means that comparison, scoring, and record storage finished. Human confirmation is recorded separately: 9 candidates had completed human verification and 331 were marked as awaiting it. Separating automated results from human review status makes the processing state of each candidate clearer.
blocks.zh: 在本报告收集的样本中,组织资产按图书馆和版本储存。 8名从业人员的记录包含6个图书馆的37个已完成的交叉审查工作,涵盖818名候选人。 “完成”是指完成的比较、评分和记录存储。 人类确认书另作记录:9名候选人已完成人类核查,331名候选人被标记为等待核查。 将自动结果与人审查状况分开,使每个候选人的处理状况更加明确。

blocks.en: For the workplace injury mediator, two rule-library review jobs used the same source version. Each involved 37 source assets and 21 candidates, with processing status retained. These records make experience traceable from its source through review and consolidation. The three-configuration evaluation demonstrates the value of the resulting organizational assets and skills in professional task execution.
blocks.zh: 对于工作场所伤害问题调解人,两个规则-图书馆审查工作使用了同一源版本。 每个项目涉及37个来源资产和21个候选人,处理状况保留。 这些记录通过审查和合并,能够从来源中追踪经验。 三次配置评价显示由此产生的组织资产和技能在专业任务执行中的价值。

blocks.en: 6  Skill Construction and Agent Integration
blocks.zh: 6 技能建设和代理整合

blocks.en: 6.1  Skill invocation and execution requirements
blocks.zh: 6.1 技能援引和执行要求

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Skill selection and execution. Retrieval retains active, authorized assets with true or unknown applicability. Invocation requires satisfied prerequisites and action checks. Missing information prompts clarification and another state check; a rejected action may lead to escalation. Actions and escalations are logged. Mandatory constraints apply independently of retrieval ranking.
blocks.zh: 图8:技能选择和执行。 检索保留有活动,授权的资产,适用性真实或未知. 援引需要满足先决条件和行动检查。 缺少信息会导致澄清和另一次国家检查;拒绝的行动可能导致升级。 行动与升级都有记录。 强制性限制的适用独立于检索排序。

blocks.en: A skill organizes assets produced through nine-layer cognitive corpus construction into a procedure an agent can call. Its specification includes applicability, inputs, output structure, ordered steps, tool dependencies, constraints, stopping conditions, evidence references, and versions. Together, these fields make the procedure’s inputs explicit and its execution and outputs checkable.
blocks.zh: 技能将通过九层认知体构建产生的资产组织成一个代理人可以调用的程序。 它的规格包括适用性,投入,输出结构,定级步骤,工具依赖性,约束,停止条件,证据引用,以及版本. 这些领域共同使程序的投入明确,其执行和产出可以核查。

blocks.en: Skill construction starts from reviewed assets. Rules support judgments and state transitions. Best practices supply candidate procedures. Constraints and negative examples define checks. Corner cases identify when to pause or adjust the usual procedure. Each skill combines these elements into a complete procedure, with suggested wording where useful. A dependency list links each part of the procedure to its supporting assets, so corrections can trigger targeted revalidation.
blocks.zh: 技能建设从审查资产开始。 规则支持判决和州过渡。 最佳做法提供候选程序。 制约和负面例子界定了检查。 转角病例表示何时暂停或调整通常程序. 每种技能都将这些要素综合为一个完整的程序,并在有用的地方建议措辞。 依赖性清单将程序的每个部分与辅助资产联系起来,因此更正可触发有针对性的重新确认。

blocks.en: The system retrieves and calls external assets during inference. Rules, constraints, and skills can therefore be updated without retraining the base model. Regression evaluation should check that a correction takes effect and that unrelated tasks do not degrade.
blocks.zh: 该系统在推断期间检索和调用外部资产。 因此,可以更新规则、制约因素和技能,而不对基本模式进行再培训。 后退评价应当检查更正是否生效,不相关任务是否降解.

blocks.en: 6.2  Selection and execution
blocks.zh: 6.2 选择和执行

Tool outputs are observations, not instructions that can override the task or platform controls. Output validation checks the required schema, reported evidence, and stopping conditions. blocks.en: Execution need not follow a fixed chain. Skills can branch, but branch conditions and allowed actions must be checkable. A new observation can invalidate a previously satisfied prerequisite, so checks must occur before action rather than only at task entry. The task record preserves the actual sequence, including failed attempts and human intervention.
blocks.zh: 执行不需要遵循固定的链条. 技能可以分支,但分支条件和允许的行动必须是可核查的. 新的观察可能会使先前满足的先决条件失效,因此检查必须在行动之前进行,而不只是在任务输入时进行。 任务记录保留了实际序列,包括失败的尝试和人类的干预.

blocks.en: 7  Case Study and Task Runs
blocks.zh: 7 个案例研究和任务运行

blocks.en: 7.1  Comparing the three configurations in workplace injury mediation
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 比较工作场所伤害调解的三种组合

blocks.en: To examine the use of extracted experience in mediation, we compared the base model, raw-corpus RAG, and KUPAS MASTER configurations for a workplace injury mediator. This practitioner supplied just 2 interview files, which produced 167 experience assets, and completed rule-library cross-review jobs.
blocks.zh: 为了审查从调解中汲取的经验的使用情况,我们比较了基层模式,即原始公司RAG和KUPAS MASTER配置,即工作场所伤害调解人。 这名从业者只提供了2份面谈档案,产生了167项经验资产,并完成了规则-图书馆交叉审查工作。

blocks.en: One representative task asked whether a traffic accident during a detour to collect a child after work could qualify as a workplace injury. The answer also had to identify evidence about the route, timing, and purpose, and set an order for addressing disputed issues in mediation. The base model provided a general framework and evidence checklist but cited no specific regulation and did not clearly distinguish mediation from formal injury determination. Raw-corpus RAG cited the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance and proposed mediation steps. The KUPAS MASTER agent additionally called the “Mediation Request Assessment and Focus” skill and consulted rule and corner-case libraries. It distinguished the boundaries of injury determination, mediation authority, and high-risk issues, and generated an output file. It was rated best on all 8 comparison items, including 1 tie with raw-corpus RAG.
blocks.zh: 一位代表询问,在下班后接送儿童途中发生的交通事故是否构成工伤。 答复还必须查明有关路线、时间和目的的证据,并为在调解中解决争议问题制定命令。 基准模式提供了一般框架和证据核对表,但没有列举具体条例,也没有明确区分调解和正式伤害认定。 Raw-corpus RAG援引了《工伤保险条例》和提议的调解步骤。 KUPAS MASTER代理商还称“调解请求评估和重点”技能,并咨询了规则和角落文件库。 它区分了伤害确定、调解权威和高风险问题的界限,并产生了产出文件。 在所有8个比较项目上评为最佳,包括1个与生公司RAG的平局.

blocks.en: Table 5: Three-configuration comparison for workplace injury mediation. All configurations assess an accident during a detour to collect a child after work, the evidence needed, and the order of mediation steps.
blocks.zh: 表5:工作场所伤害调解的三要素比较。 所有组合都评估在下班后收集儿童途中发生的事故、所需证据和调解步骤的顺序。

blocks.en: A second recorded question concerned a work-related injury with grade-ten disability, part-time employment, and several compensation amounts. The base model focused on legal principles and inferring amounts. Raw-corpus RAG added practical calculations and mediation advice. The KUPAS MASTER agent called a mediation skill and used rules and best practices to organize wage evidence, compensation calculations, reasons for employment termination, and judicial confirmation into a complete process. It also generated a “Preliminary Analysis of a Workplace Injury Mediation Case” file.
blocks.zh: 记录的第二个问题涉及与10级残疾有关的工伤、非全时工作以及若干赔偿数额。 基本模式侧重于法律原则和推断数额。 Raw-corpus RAG增加了实用计算和调解建议. KUPAS MASTER代理人称调解技巧,并采用规则和最佳做法,将工资证据、报酬计算、解雇原因和司法确认组织成一个完整的过程。 它还产生了“工作场所伤害调解案件初步分析”档案。

blocks.en: On this practitioner’s 8 evaluation questions, A, B, and C scored 73.34, 80.80, and 90.58, respectively. C exceeded B by 9.78 points. Mean end-to-end times were 13, 31, and 53 seconds. Structured experience improves the completeness and usefulness of professional analysis by supplying task boundaries, judgment conditions, and executable procedures. The comparison shows the added value of organizing source knowledge into experience assets and skills. The next two sections describe the evaluation setup and results across domains.
blocks.zh: 在这个从业人员的8个评价问题上,A、B和C分别得分73.34、80.80和90.58。 C比B高9.78点. 平均端对端时间为13,31,53秒. 结构化的经验通过提供任务界限、判断条件和可执行程序,提高了专业分析的完整性和实用性。 比较显示将原始知识组织成经验资产和技能的附加值。 下两节介绍各领域的评价设置和成果。

blocks.en: 8  Evaluation Design
blocks.zh: 8 评价设计

blocks.en: We systematically compare three configurations on a common evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine-layer cognitive corpus construction and use run records to explain how assets and skills contribute to task performance. The evaluation uses authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners and covers 177 questions and 531 responses. A uses the base model, B retrieves the raw corpus, and C uses KUPAS MASTER experience assets and skills.
blocks.zh: 我们系统地比较关于共同评价协议的三个配置,以评估九层认知体构建的有效性,并使用运行记录来解释资产和技能如何有助于任务执行。 评价使用20名随机挑选的从业人员的授权样本,涵盖177个问题和531个答复。 A使用基模,B取回生体,C使用KUPAS MASTER体验资产和技能.

blocks.en: Figure 9 : The three-configuration comparison. Direct inference provides a model-only reference. Raw-corpus RAG measures the benefit of access to source records. The KUPAS MASTER agent evaluates the complete experience-guided configuration. All three answer the same tasks under common input requirements and scoring criteria.
blocks.zh: 图9:三国交替比较. 直接推论提供了一个只使用模型的参考. Raw-corpus RAG 测量访问源记录的好处. KUPAS MASTER代理评价完整的经验引导配置. 三者在共同的输入要求和评分标准下回答相同的任务.

blocks.en: 8.1  Evaluation objectives
blocks.zh: 8.1 评价目标

blocks.en: The evaluation measures the KUPAS MASTER agent’s improvement over the base model and raw-corpus RAG. We analyze the gains alongside case representation, experience collection, consolidation, skill construction, and boundary controls to connect task results with the platform workflow.
blocks.zh: 评价衡量了KUPAS MASTER代理商对基础模型和原始公司RAG的改进。 我们分析在案例陈述、经验收集、整合、技能建设和边界控制的同时取得的成果,以便将任务成果与平台工作流程联系起来。

blocks.en: Tasks should have clear inputs, bounded goals, and assessable outputs. AgentBench and benchmarks for web, enterprise, desktop, and software tasks illustrate environment-based evaluation [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] . Benchmarks for tool and user interaction and scientific workflows further examine dialogue consistency and output validation [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] . Mediation tasks can test whether an agent identifies missing facts, selects the next information-gathering step, checks a response against reviewed criteria, or chooses an escalation path. Offline evaluation measures the accuracy and usefulness of advice. Evaluation in actual use can additionally track outcomes such as dispute resolution. Studies of professional writing and human-AI collaboration suggest focusing on task outcomes and comparing against the stronger of human-only and AI-only performance [ 29 , 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 任务应有明确的投入、有限度的目标和可评估的产出。 Bench代理和网络、企业、桌面和软件任务的基准说明了基于环境的评价[21、22、23、24、25]。 工具和用户互动的基准以及科学工作流程进一步审查对话的一致性和产出验证[26、27、28]。 调解任务可以测试代理人是否识别缺失的事实,选择下一个信息收集步骤,对照审查的标准检查答复,或者选择升级路径. 离线评价衡量咨询意见的准确性和有用性。 实际使用的评价可以进一步跟踪解决争端等结果。 对专业写作和人与AI合作的研究表明,应注重任务成果,并比较仅人与AI的性能更强[29,30].

blocks.en: 8.2  Design principles
blocks.zh: 8.2 设计原则

blocks.en: Figure 9 shows the comparison. A receives the base model, task prompt, and observations available at task entry, with no domain retrieval. B adds retrieval from raw domain records, with the parsing and indexing needed to support it. C uses assets and skills constructed from those records. Across the experiments, each configuration answers independently under the same tasks, input requirements, and scoring rubric. Model settings, sampling parameters, tool permissions, and runtime resources follow a common protocol, as do the rules for providing task clarification. This consistent setup makes the results directly comparable.
blocks.zh: 图9显示了比较情况。 A接收了任务条目上可用的基准模型,任务提示和观测,没有域检索. B增加了原始域记录的检索,并需要解析和索引来支持. C使用这些记录形成的资产和技能。 在整个实验中,每个配置在相同的任务,输入要求,以及积分标点下独立回答. 模型设置,采样参数,工具权限,运行时间资源遵循共同协议,提供任务澄清的规则也是如此. 这种一致的设置使结果可以直接比较。

blocks.en: B and C draw on the same authorized source materials, including practitioner interviews. B retrieves the original content, while C uses experience assets and skills derived from it. This shared information base allows the comparison to measure the value added by experience structuring and skill construction. Retrieval, skill calls, and end-to-end time are retained to analyze quality and resource use. Configuration records cover B’s parsing, chunking, indexing, and retrieval, and C’s corpus snapshot, experience retrieval, and skill versions.
blocks.zh: B和C利用了同样的授权来源材料,包括从业人员访谈。 B检索原始内容,而C则使用从中获得的经验资产和技能. 这一共享信息库可以进行比较,以衡量经验和技能建设带来的增值。 检索,技能调用,以及端到端的时间被保留,以分析质量和资源使用. 配置记录包括B的剖析、块化、索引和检索以及C的剖析、经验检索和技能版本。

blocks.en: 8.3  Experimental setup and data
blocks.zh: 8.3 实验设置和数据

blocks.en: KUPAS MASTER is commercially deployed and has accumulated experience from many practitioners. This report uses a random sample of 20 authorized users. Their 1,576 source files yield 30,762 retrievable chunks, 23,024 individual experience records, and 13,113 organizational assets after consolidation. The corresponding Elasticsearch indices contain 43,882 documents.
blocks.zh: KUPAS MASTER是商业部署的,积累了许多从业人员的经验。 本报告使用20个授权用户的随机抽样. 他们的1 576份原始档案在合并后产生了30 762个可检索块、23 024个个人经验记录和13 113个组织资产。 相应的弹性搜索指数包含43,882份文件.

blocks.en: Shared identifiers link processing stages. The file inventory records sources, formats, and review status. Individual records link to contributors and cases. Organizational assets add types, versions, and source relationships. Index documents support retrieval and agent use. The sources span 13 formats, and 17 of the 20 practitioners have all six asset types. These records support analysis of corpus composition, asset distributions, and use across tasks.
blocks.zh: 共享标识符连接处理阶段. 文件清单记录来源、格式和审查状况。 个人记录与捐助者和案件有联系。 组织资产增加类型、版本和源关系。 索引文档支持检索和代理使用. 来源有13种格式,20名从业人员中有17名拥有全部6种资产类型。 这些记录支持对实体构成、资产分配和跨任务使用的分析。

blocks.en: The 177 evaluation questions each receive an independent answer from A, B, and C, producing 531 responses. Domains include finance and accounting, community governance, engineering quality, safety oversight, healthcare, mediation, and emergency management. Table 6 summarizes the setup. The comparison evaluates experience use during inference: raw-corpus retrieval and structured experience assets improve task performance without retraining the base model. Reviewed experience also provides reusable material for subsequent model adaptation.
blocks.zh: 177个评价问题都得到A、B和C的独立答复,产生了531个答复。 领域包括财务和会计、社区治理、工程质量、安全监督、保健、调解和应急管理。 表6概述了设置情况。 比较评价了推论期间的经验使用:原始公司检索和结构化经验资产在不重新培训基本模式的情况下改善任务业绩. 经审查的经验还为以后的模型适应提供了可重复使用的材料。

blocks.en: An LLM applies a shared rubric to score A, B, and C on the same questions across seven dimensions: result correctness, output actionability, depth of professional judgment, evidence sufficiency and accuracy, appropriate tool and skill use, accuracy in understanding requirements, and boundaries and compliance. blocks.en: The evaluation results support paired and stratified analysis by practitioner, domain, difficulty, and task form. Detailed run traces are available for 5 practitioners and 53 questions, showing knowledge-base retrieval, raw-corpus access, asset-library calls, and skill execution. In C, 52 runs retrieved from the knowledge base and 46 called skills. Rules, corner cases, best practices, constraints, and negative examples all appear in the traces. blocks.en: Evaluation materials, run outputs, and summaries share a common data structure. Practitioner summaries retain question counts, configuration scores, failed questions, end-to-end time, and dimension scores alongside question-level results. Task records remain linked to the assets derived from their source materials. In workplace injury mediation, for example, the agent calls the “Mediation Request Assessment and Focus” skill and combines rules and corner cases to address procedural boundaries, fact verification, and risks. The dataset thus supports both outcome comparisons and analysis of the path from materials to assets, skill calls, and task outputs.
blocks.zh: 评价材料、产出和摘要共用一个共同的数据结构。 从业人员摘要保留提问计数,配置分数,故障问题,端对端时间,维度分数与问题级结果并列. 任务记录仍与其原始材料中的资产相联系。 例如,在工作场所伤害调解方面,代理人称“调解请求评估和重点”技能,并将规则和角落案件结合起来,以解决程序界限、事实核实和风险问题。 因此,数据集支持成果比较和分析从材料到资产、技能呼叫和任务产出的道路。

blocks.en: Secondary measures include factual support, procedural completeness, applicability errors, prohibited actions, unnecessary refusals, and escalation quality. Evidence faithfulness measures how well a cited passage supports the corresponding claim. Prior work studies claim-level factuality and citation verification [ 31 , 32 ] ; RAGAs and RAGChecker distinguish retrieval quality from generation quality [ 33 , 34 ] . The evaluation framework distinguishes citation coverage from factual support, checks claims against sources, and measures latency and token use under a common runtime budget. Collection and expert review costs form a separate part of the cost analysis.
blocks.zh: 次要措施包括事实支持、程序完整性、适用性错误、被禁止的行动、不必要的拒绝和升级质量。 所引述的一段话在多大程度上支持了相应的主张,证据的忠实程度衡量了这一点。 先前的工作研究:索赔一级的事实质量和引用核实[31,32];RAGAS和RAGChecker将检索质量与生成质量区分开来[33,34]. 评价框架将引用范围与事实支持区分开来,根据来源对索赔进行核对,并根据共同运行时间预算衡量延迟性和象征性使用。 收集和专家审查费用是费用分析的一个单独部分。

blocks.en: Extensions to human evaluation will use randomized output order, masked system identities where feasible, a fixed rubric, and independent review of a subset, with reviewer qualifications, agreement, and adjudication recorded. Human checks complement model scoring for calibration and scale [ 35 ] . Workflow evaluations will connect these assessments to business outcomes over a defined observation period.
blocks.zh: 对人类评价的扩展将采用随机化的产出顺序、在可行的情况下采用遮盖的系统身份、固定标题和对子集的独立审查,并记录审查者的资格、协议和裁决。 人体检查是对校准和尺度模型评分的补充[35]. 工作流程评价将在确定的观察期间将这些评估与业务成果联系起来。

blocks.en: 9.4  Sources of gains and runtime behavior
blocks.zh: 9.4 国家 收益来源和运行时间行为

blocks.en: We examine organizational asset counts, run logs, and representative tasks to understand C’s gains over raw-corpus RAG. The analysis considers asset organization, retrieval, skill use, source formats, and corpus size.
blocks.zh: 我们审查组织资产盘点、记录和代表性任务,以了解C相对于原始公司RAG的收益。 分析考虑了资产组织、检索、技能使用、来源格式和实体规模。

blocks.en: The 20 practitioners contributed 23,024 published individual entries, which became 13,113 organizational assets after consolidation. The process combines duplicate or similar experience and organizes individual entries into shared assets. Consolidation adapts to each practitioner’s source material, with the reduction reflecting differences in repetition, content structure, and organization. Retrieval then operates over structured rules, best practices, constraints, negative examples, and corner cases.
blocks.zh: 20名从业者贡献了23 024个公布的个人条目,合并后成为13 113个组织资产。 这一过程结合了重复或类似的经验,组织个人登录共享资产. 合并适应每个从业人员的原始材料,减少反映重复、内容结构和组织的不同。 然后根据结构规则、最佳做法、制约因素、负面例子和角落案例进行检索。

blocks.en: For the 5 practitioners and 53 questions with complete individual traces, C performs knowledge-base retrieval in 52 runs and calls skills in 46. Rules, corner cases, best practices, constraints, and negative examples appear in 46, 35, 33, 28, and 18 runs, respectively. Compared with B’s main reliance on raw-corpus retrieval, C combines several asset types and calls skills where needed. Table 8 summarizes their observed roles.
blocks.zh: 对于5名从业人员和53个有完整个人痕迹的问题,C在52次运行中进行知识库检索,46次呼叫技能。 规则、角落案例、最佳做法、制约因素和负面例子分别见于46、35、33、28和18。 与B主要依赖原始公司检索相比,C结合了几种资产类型,并在需要时调用技能. 表8总结了他们观察到的作用。

blocks.en: Table 8: Asset and skill use in 53 C runs for 53 questions. Counts are by run and can overlap.
blocks.zh: 表8:53 C中的资产和技能使用为53个问题。 计数通过运行,可以重叠.

blocks.en: Examples make these roles concrete. In flood and typhoon response, rules, best practices, and corner cases support judgments about water levels, dispatch order, and de-escalation conditions. In safety management, negative examples and corner cases flag hazards such as unplanned rescue attempts in confined spaces and distinctions between ordinary hazards and major accident risks. In social insurance auditing, skills organize experience into plans, checklists, review forms, and ledgers. Assets thus contribute conditions, risk boundaries, and procedures as well as retrieved text.
blocks.zh: 实例使这些作用具体化。 在洪灾和台风救灾中,规则、最佳做法和角落案例支持对水位、调度命令和降级条件作出判断。 在安全管理方面,负面例子和角落案例标出危险,如在封闭的空间进行计划外救援,区分普通危险和重大事故危险。 在社会保险审计中,技能将经验组织到计划、核对表、审查表和分类账中。 因此,资产提供了条件、风险界限和程序以及检索到的案文。

blocks.en: The gains span appropriate tool and skill use, evidence sufficiency and accuracy, depth of professional judgment, output actionability, and boundaries and compliance. Removing the appropriate tool and skill use dimension and renormalizing the remaining weights to 100 leaves an average C-minus-B gap of about 9.3 points, close to the full-score gap of 9.83. The difference extends to evidence use, judgment, and task outputs.
blocks.zh: 成果涉及适当的工具和技能使用、证据的充分性和准确性、专业判断的深度、产出可操作性、界限和遵守。 移除适当的工具和技能使用维度,将剩余重量重新正常化到100,平均C-负B差约9.3分,接近全分差9.83分. 差异扩大到证据使用、判断和任务产出。

blocks.en: All 20 practitioners gain across different corpus sizes and formats. Raw chunk counts, organizational asset counts, and library sizes show no stable relationship with C’s gain over B. Spreadsheets can produce many cell fragments, JSON contains structural fields, and documents usually provide more continuous text. The platform organizes these sources into a common representation. The consistent gains across these varied corpora demonstrate the practical value of organizing heterogeneous experience for task use.
blocks.zh: 所有20名执业者都获得了不同体积和格式的惠益。 原始块计数、组织资产计数和库大小与C的增益相比没有稳定的关系。 电子表格可以产生许多单元格碎片,JSON包含结构字段,文档通常提供更连续的文本。 该平台将这些来源组织为共同代表. 各个不同的公司不断取得收益,表明组织不同的经验用于任务的实际价值。

blocks.en: The traces show a connected process: experience extraction produces assets, retrieval combines relevant assets for the current question, and skills organize them into steps, checks, and deliverables. This workflow turns experience into stronger evidence, clearer judgments, actionable outputs, and explicit boundary checks, connecting the score improvements to concrete task behavior.
blocks.zh: 痕迹显示一个相互关联的过程:经验提取产生资产,检索结合当前问题的相关资产,技能将其组织成步骤、检查和交付品。 这一工作流程将经验转化为更强有力的证据、更明确的判断、可采取行动的产出和明确的边界检查,将分数改进与具体的任务行为联系起来。

blocks.en: 9.5  Efficiency
blocks.zh: 9.5 效率

blocks.en: Across 20 practitioners and 177 questions, mean end-to-end latency, weighting practitioners equally, is 16.2 s for A, 34.0 s for B, and 57.1 s for C. The means of practitioner-level 90th-percentile (P90) latencies are 21.1, 41.1, and 68.4 s. C’s mean latency is about 3.5 times A’s and 1.7 times B’s.
blocks.zh: 在20名从业者和177个问题中,平均端到端的耐久性,对从业者的加权相等,分别为A16.2s、B34.0s和C57.1s。 90-百分率(P90)的从业者手段为21.1、41.1和68.4s。 C的中长期性大约是A的3.5倍,B的1.7倍.

blocks.en: In the detailed-trace subset of 5 practitioners and 53 questions, C performs knowledge-base retrieval in 52 runs and calls skills in 46. Library usage is 46 for rules, 35 for corner cases, 33 for best practices, 28 for constraints, and 18 for negative examples. Mean latency on this same subset is 17.4, 36.2, and 59.1 s for A, B, and C.
blocks.zh: 在由5名从业人员和53个问题组成的详细追踪子集中,C在52次运行中进行知识库检索,46次呼叫技能. 图书馆使用规则为46个,角落案件为35个,最佳做法为33个,限制为28个,负面实例为18个。 同一子集的平均延迟度为17.4 36.2,A、B和C为59.1s。

blocks.en: The platform delivers stronger professional judgments, better supporting evidence, and actionable outputs in about a minute on average. This response time accommodates experience retrieval, asset checks, and skill execution within a practical workflow for business analysis, planning, and professional review. The result is a substantial quality improvement with a response window suited to these tasks.
blocks.zh: 该平台平均在约一分钟内提供更强有力的专业判断、更好的证据和可采取行动的产出。 这一响应时间在业务分析、规划和专业审查的实用工作流程中满足了经验检索、资产检查和技能执行的需要。 其结果是,质量大有改进,有一个适合这些任务的反应窗口。

blocks.en: 10  Commercial Deployment
blocks.zh: 10 商业部署

blocks.en: KUPAS MASTER is a commercial platform with cloud and local deployment options. It separates corpus production, asset management, agent execution, and evaluation records, and uses permissions, versions, and run records to manage access across these stages. The experiments use the release dated September 16, 2026. The platform continues to evolve.
blocks.zh: KUPAS MASTER是一个具有云和本地部署选项的商业平台. 它将生产、资产管理、代理执行和评价记录分开,并使用权限、版本和运行记录来管理这些阶段的访问。 实验使用了2026年9月16日的释放. 平台不断发展.

blocks.en: 10.1  Customized local deployment
blocks.zh: 10.1 定制当地部署

blocks.en: The platform supports deployment of corpus processing, asset management, retrieval, and agent execution on customer-owned servers or a private cloud. Domain terms, library structures, review rules, and skill workflows can be configured for an industry’s requirements and business processes.
blocks.zh: 该平台支持在客户拥有的服务器或私人云上部署实体处理、资产管理、检索和代理执行。 域名、图书馆结构、审查规则和技能工作流程可以根据行业的要求和业务流程加以配置。

blocks.en: For applications with strict confidentiality requirements, local model inference and internal tool services can keep source materials, assets, task inputs, outputs, and logs within the customer environment. In this configuration, business data need not pass through external model APIs or third-party services. Authentication, role-based permissions, access isolation, and audit logs govern collection, sharing, and agent use. Customers can control where data are stored, how they are used, and who can access them, while retaining a record of operations.
blocks.zh: 对于严格保密要求的应用程序,本地模型推论和内部工具服务可以将源材料,资产,任务投入,产出,日志保存在客户环境中. 在这个配置中,商业数据不需要通过外部模型API或第三方服务. 认证、基于角色的授权、访问隔离和审计日志管理收集、共享和代理使用。 客户可以控制数据的存储地点,如何使用,以及谁可以访问,同时保留业务记录.

blocks.en: 11  Related Work
blocks.zh: 11 相关工作

blocks.en: The Critical Decision Method and Applied Cognitive Task Analysis use questions about specific incidents to recover cues, judgments, and strategies missing from routine records [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Organizational knowledge creation also studies how individual knowledge becomes shared practice [ 36 ] . KUPAS MASTER applies these ideas to the design of records for agents. Its nine dimensions organize expert judgments, actions, and feedback into experience that can be extracted, reviewed, and reused.
blocks.zh: 《关键决策方法和应用认知任务分析》利用与具体事件有关的问题来恢复常规记录中缺失的提示、判断和战略[3、4、5]。 组织知识创造还研究个人知识如何成为共同做法[36]。 KUPAS MASTER将这些想法应用于特工记录的设计. 它的九个层面组织专家的判断、行动和对经验的反馈,这些经验可以提取、审查和再利用。

blocks.en: Dense Passage Retrieval and Fusion-in-Decoder study learned retrieval and generation from multiple passages [ 37 , 38 ] . Self-RAG adds retrieval and self-critique decisions, while RAPTOR organizes recursive summaries [ 39 , 40 ] . GraphRAG and LightRAG retrieve linked information through graphs [ 7 , 41 ] , and HippoRAG 2 studies nonparametric continual learning [ 42 ] . These approaches offer alternatives to a simple raw-corpus index. A longer context alone does not ensure that a model uses the relevant evidence [ 43 ] . Our focus is the experience contributed by practitioners and the conditions under which it applies.
blocks.zh: Dense Passage Retrieval and Fusion-in-Decoder研究从多个段落中学习了检索和生成[37,38]. Self-RAG增加了检索和自我批评的决定,而RAPTOR则组织递归性摘要[39,40]. GraphRAG和LightRAG通过图[7,41]检索链接信息,HippoRAG 2研究非参数持续学习[42]. 这些办法为简单的原始公司指数提供了替代办法。 仅靠较长的上下文并不能确保模型使用相关证据[43]。 我们的重点是从业人员提供的经验及其适用的条件。

blocks.en: CoALA distinguishes memory and action components in language agents [ 44 ] . Generative Agents uses experience records and reflection to guide simulated behavior [ 45 ] . Reflexion and ExpeL derive reusable feedback from agent attempts [ 46 , 47 ] . A-Mem and Mem0 study structured or consolidated memory, while ACE and LangMem support evolving context and persistent memory [ 48 , 49 , 50 , 51 ] . KUPAS MASTER focuses on externally collected practitioner accounts, claim-level evidence, conditional disagreements, and review before use. This approach brings practitioner expertise and its supporting evidence into agent memory and reuse.
blocks.zh: CoALA区分语言代理中的记忆和动作组件[44]. 基因代理使用经验记录和反射来指导模拟行为[45]. Reflexion and ExpeL从代理尝试中获得可重复使用的反馈[46,47]. A-Mem和Mem0研究结构化或集成内存,而ACE和LangMem则支持不断演变的背景和持久性内存[48,49,50,51]. KUPAS MASTER侧重于外部收集的从业人员账户、索赔层面的证据、有条件的分歧以及使用前的审查。 这种方法将从业者的专门知识及其辅助证据纳入剂内存和再利用。

blocks.en: Toolformer studies learned tool use, and ReAct combines reasoning with environment interaction [ 52 , 8 ] . Voyager maintains executable skills, and Agent Workflow Memory derives reusable workflows from past trajectories [ 53 , 54 ] . AutoGen, MetaGPT, DSPy, and AgentScope provide orchestration or program construction mechanisms [ 55 , 56 , 57 , 9 ] . KUPAS MASTER can supply reviewed content to these systems. Our focus is the evidence and dependency requirements of the procedures passed to an executor, building on existing orchestration work.
blocks.zh: Toolfer研究学习工具的使用,ReAct将推理与环境相互作用相结合[52,8]. Voyager保持可执行技能,Agent Workflow Memory从过去的轨迹中获得可重复使用的工作流程[53,54]. AutoGen,MetaGPT,DSPy,和AgentScope提供管弦乐或程序构建机制[55,56,57,9]. KUPAS MASTER可以向这些系统提供经过审查的内容。 我们的重点是在现有协调工作的基础上向执行人提出的程序的证据和依赖性要求。

blocks.en: AMIE studies conversational diagnosis, and subsequent work extends conversational AI to disease management [ 58 , 59 ] . Agents for scientific instruments and Co-Scientist study tool-based workflows and scientist-guided discovery, respectively [ 60 , 61 ] . These studies inform evidence organization, expert assessment, and task validation in professional settings. The platform improves agents through external experience corpora accessed during inference, without requiring base-model retraining.
blocks.zh: AMIE研究对话诊断,随后的工作将对话AI扩展至疾病管理[58,59]. 科学仪器代理和基于共同科学家研究工具的工作流程和科学家指导的发现分别[60,61]. 这些研究为组织证据、专家评估和在专业环境中确认任务提供了信息。 该平台通过在推论期间访问的外部经验公司改进代理商,而不需要基模再培训.

blocks.en: 12  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 12. 结论

blocks.en: We presented KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns practitioners’ tacit experience into structured assets that can be traced and reused. Six case elements, nine extraction dimensions, and six asset types connect case records to experience and callable skills. Semantic alignment, individual distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review retain sources, conditions, and disagreements. Explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions connect these assets to task execution and evaluation feedback.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了KUPAS MASTER, 一个经验工程平台 围绕九层认知体的构建。 它将从业人员的默认经验转化为结构化资产,可以追踪和再利用。 6个案件要素、9个提取维度和6个资产类型将案件记录与经验和可调用技能联系起来。 语义协调、个别提炼、组织整合和交叉审查保留来源、条件和分歧。 明确的投入、步骤、依赖性和停止条件将这些资产与任务执行和评价反馈联系起来。

blocks.en: Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual records and 13,113 organizational assets. Across 177 questions and 531 responses produced under a common task protocol and evaluated with a shared rubric, the base model, raw-corpus RAG, and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58 when practitioner means were weighted equally. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG by 9.83 points and gained in all seven dimensions. Run records confirm that assets and skills supplied judgment conditions, identified risk boundaries, and organized task procedures. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of nine-layer cognitive corpus construction, with consistent advantages in task quality, evidence use, and boundary handling. The platform turns individual tacit experience into organizational knowledge and agent capabilities through a complete engineering workflow, from experience capture to practical application.
blocks.zh: 该平台利用20名随机选择的从业人员的授权样本,将1 576份源文件处理成23 024份个人记录和13 113份组织资产。 在177个问题和531个答复中,根据共同任务协议提出,并用一个共同标题加以评价的基数模型、原始公司RAG和KUPAS MASTER剂得到70.63、79.75和89.58的分数,而从业者的手段是同等加权的。 KUPAS MASTER剂在原始公司RAG上改进了9.83分,并在所有7个维度上都得到了提升. 运行记录证实,资产和技能提供了判断条件,确定了风险界限,并确定了有组织的任务程序。 这些结果表明了九层认知体构造的有效性,在任务质量、证据使用和边界处理方面有着一致的优势。 该平台通过一个完整的工程工作流程,从获取经验到实际应用,将个人的默认经验转化为组织知识和代理能力。

blocks.en: By bringing expert judgment, practical methods, and execution boundaries into agent workflows, KUPAS MASTER provides a foundation for staff development, business collaboration, and professional services. Its traceable assets preserve organizational know-how and make professional experience reusable across tasks. Future development will expand the asset base and applications, streamline experience capture and reuse, and strengthen sharing, review, updates, and application feedback. These advances will help organizations build lasting knowledge assets and apply AI to increasingly demanding decisions and tasks.
blocks.zh: KUPAS MASTER通过将专家判断、实用方法和执行界限纳入代理工作流程,为工作人员发展、业务协作和专业服务奠定了基础。 其可追踪资产保存了组织专门技能,使专业经验可重复用于各种任务。 未来的发展将扩大资产基础和应用程序,简化经验获取和再利用,并加强共享、审查、更新和应用反馈。 这些进步将帮助各组织建立持久的知识资产,并将AI应用于要求越来越高的决定和任务.
